Exactly one comparison visual, not a dashboard
No eyebrow, footer, or page numbers anywhere
Ember accent reserved strictly for emphasis, never base decoration

anti_slop_profile: no repeated eyebrow or icon strip
one comparison visual only, not multiple charts
design_plan.goal: Convince leaders motivation is the control layer for reliable agents
design_plan.rhythm: cover asymmetric type block, then loop diagram, then split scenario with resolution band, then two-column comparison, then checklist close
design_plan.signature: single control rail motif marking emphasis, never repeated as decoration
design_plan.subject: PSI agent architecture and motivation as control signal

goal: Convince leaders that motivation-based arbitration, not prompt heuristics, is the correct control layer for reliable agent behavior
image_strategy_rationale: The subject is a precise architectural mechanism (motive arbitration); native labeled shapes keep every relationship editable and legible, and the brief explicitly forbids screenshots or baked-in text

plan_critique.revision_made: Redesigned the scenario slide with a full-width resolution band beneath two panels, the comparison slide as a single row-ruled table rather than boxed cards, removed the invented eyebrow chrome placeholder from the cover, and raised all loop-node sub-labels and the feedback label to 24px so every required descendant meets the 24px floor
plan_critique.weakest_point: Initial scenario and comparison slides risked converging on the same two-column panel look as the loop slide, weakening variety; also the cover carried an unused eyebrow-space chrome element and loop-node labels were sub-minimum size

slide_compositions.composition_rationale: Left-anchored vertical ember rail plus large type block creates a decisive, uncluttered open, with no eyebrow chrome
slide_compositions.headline_intent: State the thesis that motivation is the control signal
slide_compositions.structural_fingerprint: vertical ember rail at far left with stacked left-aligned type block, no right-side content

slide_compositions.composition_rationale: Four equal nodes in a horizontal row with connecting bars mirror a control loop; feedback bar underneath closes the cycle visually
slide_compositions.headline_intent: Show the four-stage motivation control loop with feedback
risk_notes: connector bars aligned to node vertical centerline at top:547px
slide_compositions.structural_fingerprint: four horizontal boxes with connectors, single feedback bar spanning beneath

slide_compositions.composition_rationale: Two motive panels side by side in tension, resolved by a single banded panel beneath, differs structurally from the loop slide
slide_compositions.headline_intent: Ground the loop in one concrete scenario of competing motives resolving to an action
slide_compositions.structural_fingerprint: two side-by-side panels above one full-width resolution band

slide_compositions.composition_rationale: One two-column table-like comparison with a single vertical divider avoids dashboard-card sameness while staying data-honest
slide_compositions.headline_intent: Contrast baseline agent behavior against motivation-governed agent across four engineering dimensions in one comparison, not a dashboard
risk_notes: keep exactly one comparison structure per brief restraint requirement
slide_compositions.structural_fingerprint: single two-column comparison with horizontal row rules and one vertical divider, no card grid

slide_compositions.composition_rationale: Four stacked left-border checklist rows followed by one large closing line differs from all prior slide structures and ends on synthesis
slide_compositions.headline_intent: Give an operational checklist then land a memorable closing line
slide_compositions.structural_fingerprint: four stacked bordered rows above one large standalone closing statement

story_arc: Open with a decisive thesis, show the native control loop mechanism, ground it in one concrete scenario of competing motives, contrast engineering outcomes against baseline agents, close with an operational checklist and memorable line
subject: PSI agent architecture and motivation as a control signal for autonomous agents
viewing_context: Projected in a technical product review; also reviewed asynchronously on a laptop
